Name: Basic
Note: Automatic and free. It IS weapon damage, which is what makes it the anchor every other slot is measured against.

Name: Heavy
Note: The design calls it often the primary damage button, on a moderate cooldown.

Name: Special
Note: Traps, deployables, grenades, pets. The most varied slot, so the widest band below its typical value.

Name: Support
Note: Buffs, shields, stances, curses, banners. Usually no damage at all, which is why its typical value is zero.

Name: Aura
Note: Persistent and toggled, draining resource per second. This is per second rather than per use.

Name: Ultimate
Note: The band is the two designed Ultimates: Annihilator states 300% and Skull Splitter states 500%.

Name: Movement
Note: Gap closers and escapes. The design says some also deal damage, so a basic attack's worth is the right middle.
